contradicting_evidence: The advance ratio improved by 0.26 versus the prior packet, although this does not prove durable expansion.
Mid-alt strength is broad within its observed bucket rather than attributable solely to one positive outlier.
ETF outflows are smaller than in the prior packet, especially for ETH; selling pressure may be moderating even though flows remain negative.
ETH/BTC has improved slightly, providing tentative relative stabilization rather than confirmed leadership.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Choppy stabilization attempts remain vulnerable to renewed weakness over the next three days. The downside bias rests on liquidity contraction and incomplete transmission, not on assuming that the structural prior must occur. A sustained recovery requires more than a single breadth improvement or reduced outflows.
falsification_conditions: Sustained BTC/ETH price gains with persistent ETH/BTC improvement and participation broadening beyond mid-alts would invalidate the downside base case.
Repeated positive settled ETF flows, together with resilient prices and stabilizing stablecoin supply, would materially weaken the liquidity-based bearish inference.
Continued breadth improvement across independent observations, supported by positive medians rather than extreme means, would contradict the incomplete-repair interpretation.
missing_evidence: No multi-session ETF-flow sequence establishes whether reduced outflows are persistent.
Stablecoin supply contraction is observed, but exchange availability and actual risk-asset deployment are unknown.
Repeated source-qualified breadth and ETH/BTC observations are absent.
Lagged macro levels do not establish the current direction of the macro impulse.
supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply declined 0.31% over one day, 1.59% over seven days and 4.92% over thirty days, indicating a contracting supply-liquidity backdrop.
Both BTC and ETH had negative final settled ETF totals in the latest available session.
The latest price-down/open-interest-up observations do not confirm deleveraging or a spot-led recovery.
Large-alt participation remains below half, small-alt median performance is approximately flat, and canonical broad-alt confirmation is absent.
Only 24.5% of the observed altseason constituents outperformed BTC over thirty days, providing context against assuming an established broad rotation.
